increments.title: Canonical obligation mapping table A-id <-> B-uuid + B-name
increments.detail: Produce mapping.json covering all 44 both ways; machine-check totality (every A id maps, every B uuid maps, no orphans). 28 exact name matches + 13 renames are mechanical; the ~6 genuine deltas go to inc-002.

increments.title: Delta register — RESCOPED by inc-001's findings
increments.detail: RESCOPED. Read PLAN Sec 2.1's findings table first (6 divergences inc-001 surfaced) and mapping.json's notes. The register must cover FIVE classes, not one: (1) TOPOLOGY — documents: A is a repeatable collection (cap 10), B is top-level singletons; retrofitting B as-is caps the user at ONE document. This is a REQUIREMENTS ruling for the PO, not port/drop/defer. (2) WHITELIST MEMBERSHIP — earTag/tattoo/cph/containsUnweanedAnimals differ in members, not just vocabulary; B's are V4-audited, A's predate the audit; the earTag gap PROPAGATES through the derived-complement gates on identificationDetails/description. (3) SEMANTIC CONFLICTS — regionCode purge disagreement (one side contradicts V4; touches ruling c-017), transitedCountries opposite mandate. (4) STRUCTURAL KEYS — A-only maxEntriesFrom + requiredAtLeastOne on unitRecord have no B counterpart. (5) TRUE CAPABILITY DELTAS — A-only importType, declaration; B-only commodityType ONLY (poApprovedReferenceNumber is system-minted, responsiblePersonForLoad comes from gov.identity — both on B's own KNOWN_UNWIRED list, neither is a gap). One proposed ruling each, with evidence and a recommendation. Flag which need the PO vs which Sam can rule.

Per-record mandate: try to construct a rule A expresses and B cannot — if none exists, Phase 5 is not a regression and Paul's YAGNI call stands. multi: confirm the widget->persistence coupling dies with contract.js. pathPrefix: confirm latent (gate-at-depth-1 only) and write the failing depth-2-gate test.

ALREADY RULED 2026-07-17: PLAN Sec 5.4 domain fork (no display logic in the model; strip labels; MDM is the source of options); scope M0-M4; run-id EUDPA-288 Phase 7. Also record the BRIEF:7-8 presentation deviation.

increments.title: Extend obligation-purity.js to a key-level assert
increments.detail: RULING 2026-07-17. A's obligation-purity.js (46 LOC) already asserts a feature's obligations.js may import ONLY another obligations.js or services/<name>/index.js — it encodes 'no display logic in the model' AND permits exactly the MDM route the ruling mandates. Keep it, re-point at the vendored model, and extend: fail the build if any obligation or domain entry carries label/title/titleKey/hint/legend/widget. REPORT:460-465 refutes the import-specifier regex as a structural guarantee ('never inspects a key') — the key-level assert is what turns the ruling into a gate.

increments.title: Delegate MDM-backed domain options to A's services
increments.detail: RULING 2026-07-17: 'use the most realistic source at any given point — we have the MDM integrations, use them.' B declares a staticEnum of 25 countries; A pulls the real list from reference-data via services/countries/client.js, primed at boot. Re-point countries, ports, commodities, document-types, certification-purposes. B's computedEnum(options: (fulfilments, ctx) => string[], {readsFrom}) already has the right signature and A's services are sync after boot priming, so B's contract does not change. Entries with no MDM source stay static, CODES ONLY. Protects the MDM seam REPORT:627 calls 'what A has that B has no answer for and must survive any retrofit'.

Edit B's manifest (model/obligations/obligations.js): (1) regionOfOriginCode gate the no/unset branch inScope:false via equalsGate(regionOfOriginCodeRequirement,'yes',...) so it wipes on 'no' (c-017 — Sam struck B's retain claim by name), and DELETE B's misleading 'V4 does not purge regionCode' comment; (2) transitedCountries whenTrue branch status:'mandatory' (c-038 REQUIRED under land transport). increments.title: Give B a documents collection (D1 topology) — unblocks inc-017 flow re-point
increments.detail: MODEL_EXTENDER, pre-ruled (V4 = cap-10 documents collection; c-034/journey-spec:1353; register D1 'A right'). Discovered blocking inc-017: A's dispatch totality expects the 4 accompanyingDocument* fields nested under a `documents` collection (path documents.accompanyingDocumentType), but B models them TOP-LEVEL singletons, so a B-manifest walk fails 'collected by no page'. Give B a `documents` group obligation and make the 4 accompanyingDocument{Type,AttachmentType,Reference,DateOfIssue} `within: documents` (mirror A's features/documents/obligations.js: collection with 4 items; cap 10 enforced controller-side in A, so no maxEntriesFrom needed on the model). Convert accompanyingDocumentBlockApplyTo from a SCALAR presentGate (reads fulfilments[type.id]) to a PER-RECORD projecting gate (like allowListed does for unitRecord/permanentAddress): for each document instance, if its accompanyingDocumentType is present, that instance's other fields are in scope. This is per-record SCOPE (B expresses it), NOT per-record mandate (Phase-5, which B can't) — inc-003 confirmed. If B's helpers can't express per-record present-projection without a new helper, add a minimal one (DESIGN-DELTA + coverage/witness per the STRUCTURED_HELPER_TYPES tax). Then: update B model tests asserting the old top-level shape; simplify inc-008's bridge DOCUMENT_FIELD_AIDS special-casing (documents is now a normal A-collection<->B-collection mapping); update the oracle's isStructuralBOnly/isStructuralAOnly (documents should now AGREE as a normal collection, not be excluded). Default a byte-identical; oracle stays zero-divergence (or documents newly AGREES). Mark D1 RESOLVED in retrofit/DIVERGENCE-REGISTER.md.

increments.title: maxEntriesFrom — the one genuine A-can/B-cannot capability (DEFERRED to here by Sam)
increments.detail: RULING 2026-07-17: 'defer — needs handling but push to the end; get the thing mostly done then come back.' This is the ONLY thing A expresses that B genuinely cannot (inc-003 audited all 15 A keys). Caps animal identifiers at numberOfAnimals; ruled by c-031, built at A's inc-063/DESIGN-DELTA #15. UNDER-SCOPED: it is ADMISSION CONTROL (appendEntryAt rejects at the cap, never trims), and B has NO admission-control surface AND no numeric channel (scope is boolean, status an enum, minEntries is a literal not a reference; buildImplication's group branch evaluator.js:515-525 ignores applyTo's records). Recommended home: A-side write-path (A's barrel already exposes collectionCapAt) rather than extending B's evaluator — cheaper, no MODEL_EXTENDER, no change to B's contract. Confirm that call when picked up. NOTE requiredAtLeastOne is NOT part of this — it is a one-line wire of B's generic requires.minEntries onto unitRecord (do it wherever unitRecord is first vendored).
